body: Large audio-language models (LALMs) frequently exhibit object hallucination, affirming absent sounds. The dominant mitigation, Audio-Aware Decoding (AAD), contrasts logits under real audio against an all-zero "blank" waveform, flagged by prior review as out-of-distribution. We introduce a black-box causal test that isolates the claimed evidence itself: localize a claim's evidence region via CLAP similarity, remove it by spectral gating, and compare against a random-window control across a 2x2x2 grid on three LALMs. On Qwen2-Audio-7B, localized ablation's raw AUROC trails blank's (0.613 vs. 0.721); this is a duration confound, not a localization failure, since blank removes the entire clip versus the grid's 2-4 s. Holding duration fixed, localization beats random removal at every cell on both models. Raw detection value remains model-dependent, especially on Audio Flamingo 3. The same evidence corrects decoding: contrastive decoding combining blank and language-prior contrasts, gated and ensembled, raises Qwen2-Audio accuracy from 57.1% to 71.9%, beating AAD alone. A unified causal-grounding profile does not transfer between models, indicating different grounding regimes. The source code and a detailed report of our findings, including identified limitations, are available at https://github.com/khalooei/causa.
summaryZh: 该研究提出了一种黑盒因果审计方法，用于分析大型音频语言模型（LALM）在物体声音识别中的幻觉问题。通过定位和移除声学证据区域，并与随机对照进行比较，研究发现不同模型（如Qwen2-Audio-7B和Audio Flamingo 3）的幻觉根源和对证据的依赖程度不同。研究还提出了一种结合空白波形和语言先验的对比解码策略，该策略在Qwen2-Audio-7B上将准确率从57.1%提高到71.9%，优于现有的音频感知解码（AAD）方法。结果表明，模型的因果接地特征不具有跨模型迁移性。
